q: In the end, the greaseball is returned to his shotgun wedding. The bride is shocked to see her groom returned and more shocked to find he now has Vulcan ears. The groom, seeing a way out of marriage to an ugmo, performs the Vulcan death grip on his would-be in-laws and escapes single to live another day.
2010, Andrew Schanie, Movie Confidential: Sex, Scandal, Murder and Mayhem in the Film Industry:

“That's what I thought. Christie up against a bunch of losers, you up against a bunch of ugmos...”
He smiled. “So I'm not an ugmo, gee, thanks.”
